content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UDD Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download application form and ToR from www.udd.uk.gov.in. Submit application with self-attested CV, educational and experience certificates. Send via registered/speed post to Director, Urban Development Directorate, 31/62, Rajpur Road, Dehradun, Uttarakhand-248001. Mention name of post applied on top of the envelope. Make sure it reaches by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for UDD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in UDD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies: 1 Urban Infrastructure Expert, 1 Urban Planner, 1 MIS Expert, 3 District Mission Manager, 2 Cluster Urban Planner.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for UDD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (www.udd.uk.gov.in) and send it to Director, Urban Development Directorate, 31/62, Rajpur Road, Dehradun, Uttarakhand-248001, by registered/speed post, to reach by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 80,000 for Urban Infrastructure Expert, 80,000 for Urban Planner, 60,000 for MIS Expert, 60,000 for District Mission Manager, 60,000 for Cluster Urban Planner.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduate/Post Graduate in Civil Engineering, Planning, IT, Computer Science, MCA, or Management with relevant experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Registered member of ITPI required for Urban Planner and Cluster Urban Planner. No application entertained in person or email. No TA/DA for interview.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting. Interview. Shortlisted candidates will be informed about date and venue of interview by email/mobile.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely on temporary basis. Services may be extended up to mission period. Subject to annual performance evaluation.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Dehradun.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Self-attested copy of latest CV; Educational certificates; Experience certificates.
